    I, if i were into clobbering files, would take the liberty of editing
the file as follows:
    (SETQ C 118937307725496656754857164120791261365228885. 
	  D 6296488643826193618261. 
	  Q (QUOTIENT C D)
	  R (REMAINDER C D)
	  C* (PLUS (TIMES Q D) R)
	  BMTLOSES (EQUAL C C*)
	  LISPLOSES (EQUAL R D))
and you will in fact find that LISPLOSES is T.
